entries.title: Understanding Violent and Non-Violent Right-Wing Extremist Activity Online: Part I – The Research and Its Context
entries.summary: Research project examining online posting behaviours of violent and non-violent right-wing extremists on Stormfront forum. Addresses gap in empirical knowledge about how violent extremists use online spaces and whether they can be identified before offline attacks.

entries.title: Sockpuppets rewrote Wikipedia to present Democratic candidates as socialists
entries.summary: Covers use of sockpuppet accounts to edit Wikipedia articles presenting Democratic candidates as socialists.

entries.title: Ofcom consults on strengthened industry Codes requiring faster removal of online intimate image abuse
entries.summary: Covers Ofcom consultation on strengthened industry codes requiring faster removal of online intimate image abuse.

entries.title: Views from Ukraine on Digitalised Warfare
entries.summary: Ukraine's digitalised warfare relies on integrated systems and data under strong centralised authority rather than AI. Provides lessons for UK and NATO strategy.

entries.title: Russia's New Cruise Missiles and the Rapid Iteration Trap
entries.summary: Russia's jet-powered mini cruise missiles proved faster than Ukraine's interceptor drones. Argues rapid iteration depends fundamentally on sovereign engineering capability developed over years.

entries.title: Microsoft: China’s Salt Typhoon hackers are using Artex
entries.summary: Microsoft reports that Chinese and North Korean hacking groups are rapidly integrating Artex, an AI tool linked to several high-profile breaches, into their attack suites.

entries.title: Australia passes tough legislation requiring big tech to preempt foreseeable harms
entries.summary: Australia's Digital Duty of Care Act passed Parliament, mandating online providers establish protocols protecting users from threats of violence, rape and other significant harms.

entries.title: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future
entries.summary: Google filed a patent for My Channel, a system generating personalised AI videos and advertisements using demographic data and viewing history. The patent was rejected but Google may appeal or resubmit an amended version.

entries.title: The ‘True Crime Community’ Is Inspiring Violent Attacks Through TikTok
entries.summary: Research shows attacks linked to young people obsessed with mass shooters are increasing, with the network using TikTok and AI to spread its nihilistic message.

entries.title: Podcast: The AI Tool Hacking the Planet
entries.summary: Weekly podcast covering ARTEX, an AI hacking framework behind global breaches; Google's planned 24/7 AI-powered TV channel; and a data centre construction project.

entries.title: Treasury CIO Is Vibe Coding a ‘Civilization’ Clone During Treasury Department Hack
entries.summary: Treasury Department CIO Sam Corcos updated his AI-generated Civilization clone Legatum whilst FinCEN dealt with a cybersecurity incident that disabled a critical bank compliance reporting panel.

entries.title: When cable faults raise security concerns: Australia’s role in Southeast Asia
entries.summary: Policy brief examines how Australia could assist Southeast Asian partners responding to submarine telecommunications cable incidents raising security concerns, through bilateral relationships and existing defence arrangements.

entries.title: High spending, low impact: Can Germany’s defence policy deliver on strategic ambition – and deter Russia?
entries.summary: Examines whether Germany's defence spending and policy can achieve strategic ambitions and deter Russia.

entries.title: Threat actor use of Artex hacking framework surges
entries.summary: Artex, an open-source AI penetration testing framework, surged in November with 130+ variants observed. Servers running autonomous offensive frameworks doubled from 3,200 to over 6,400 between 6–24 November.

entries.title: Europe prepares for EU Quantum Act
entries.summary: European Commission establishes quantum computing framework to develop sovereign capabilities and commercial advantage. Proposes EU Quantum Act to reduce fragmentation, align efforts, and prepare for post-quantum cryptography. Includes Sovereign Tech Equity Fund for financing, pan-European research infrastructures, Quantum Strategy Board, and European Quantum Alliance of stakeholders.

entries.title: As Drones and Temperatures Fall in Kyiv
entries.summary: Title concerns drones and temperatures in Kyiv, but no text supplied to summarise.

entries.title: The Download: AI swamping open records, and firefighting for permafrost
entries.summary: AI-powered startups raising over $100 million to collect government data and generate business signals, whilst chatbots ease public records requests. Some states pass legislation to deny requests, potentially reducing transparency. Separately, researchers investigate wildfires' acceleration of permafrost thaw and greenhouse gas release in Arctic regions.

entries.summary: Title concerns US approval of SpaceX plan to deploy million data satellites to space, but no text supplied to summarise.
